name: Revdoku
description: Gives AI agents their own email addresses with per-mailbox file storage: receive mail and attachments, send replies and upload files via REST API, hosted MCP server or CLI.

skills.name: Mailbox Management
skills.description: Create, list, update, archive and delete mailboxes via /v1/mailboxes, each with its own address.

skills.name: Read Email & Attachments
skills.description: List and read received email and download attachments with listEmails, getEmail and getAttachmentDownload.

skills.name: Send Email
skills.description: Send email and threaded replies to allowed recipients with sendEmail and in_reply_to.

skills.name: Mailbox File Storage
skills.description: Upload, list, rename, move, copy and download files in a mailbox, plus append text and bulk uploads.

skills.name: Email Events
skills.description: Register a per-mailbox webhook URL with a signing secret, or open a WebSocket ticket for live email events.

skills.name: Address Settings
skills.description: Manage the primary address, alias addresses, allowed senders and custom email domains for a mailbox.
